sentences.text: Saint Catherine of Alexandria , also known as Saint Catherine of the Wheel and The Great Martyr Saint Catherine is , according to tradition , a Christian saint and virgin , who was martyred in the early 4th century at the hands of the pagan emperor Maxentius .	Alexandria	Alexandria	pagan	Paganism	Christian	Christian	saint	saint	virgin	virgin	martyred	martyred	Maxentius	Maxentius	Great Martyr	Great Martyr

According to her hagiography , she was both a princess and a noted scholar , who became a Christian around the age of fourteen , and converted hundreds of people to Christianity .	Christian	Christian	hagiography	hagiography	Christianity	Christianity
She was martyred around the age of 18 .	martyred	martyred
Over 1,100 years following her martyrdom , Saint Joan of Arc identified Catherine as one of the Saints who appeared to her and counselled her .	martyrdom	martyrdom	Saint Joan of Arc	Saint Joan of Arc

The Eastern Orthodox Church venerates her as a Great Martyr and celebrates her feast day on 24 or 25 November -LRB- depending on the regional tradition -RRB- .	Orthodox Church	Orthodox Church	Eastern Orthodox Church	Eastern Orthodox Church	Great Martyr	Great Martyr	feast day	feast day
In Catholicism she is traditionally revered as one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers .	Fourteen Holy Helpers	Fourteen Holy Helpers

In 1969 the Roman Catholic Church removed her feast day from the General Roman Calendar ; however , she continued to be commemorated in the Roman Martyrology on 25 November .	Roman Catholic Church	Roman Catholic Church	feast day	feast day	General Roman Calendar	General Roman Calendar	Roman Martyrology	Roman Martyrology
In 2002 , her feast was restored to the General Roman Calendar as an optional memorial .	General Roman Calendar	General Roman Calendar
